changes.detail: Moved the lesson hero and learning stages before the course browser. Reduced the hero spacing and replaced repeated academy branding with a localized learning label.
Restyled the four learning stages as a compact segmented control with clear active state and distinct example icon.
Removed the decorative hero circle, divider and repeated stage underline decorations.
Replaced slash-based lesson counters with localized phrases to avoid confusing Arabic bidirectional ordering.
Course progress, search and previous/next navigation now appear when the course browser is expanded. Existing footer navigation remains available.

summary: Put the lesson title first, simplify the learning stages and collapse course navigation to leave more room for learning.
